title: Coconut Almond Cluster Granola
changes_from_base: Built for big clusters: part of the oats and coconut are ground to a flour, the rest are bound with a simmered coconut oil, maple, sugar and coconut milk syrup, squeezed into clumps on two trays and flipped rather than stirred.
summary: Coconut-studded clusters bound with a mixture of toasted oat flour and maple syrup, creating a tender granola that's crisp on the outside and chewy within.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 165 °C (145 °C fan) with shelves in the upper and lower thirds; line 2 large rimmed baking trays with baking paper.

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Simmer 120 ml coconut oil, 1 tbsp olive oil, 160 ml maple syrup, 160 g light brown sugar, 160 ml coconut milk and 1½ tsp fine salt in a medium saucepan over low heat, stirring, until the sugar dissolves; remove from the heat and add 2 tsp vanilla.

steps.title: Flour
steps.text: Blitz 105 g rolled oats with 12 g coconut flakes in a food processor or blender until you have a fine flour.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: In a large bowl, combine the oat flour, 350 g remaining rolled oats, the rest of the coconut flakes, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp ground ginger (or cardamom), 85 g flaked almonds, 70 g pumpkin seeds and 65 g sunflower seeds; pour in the warm syrup and stir thoroughly, then leave to thicken for 10 min.

steps.title: Form
steps.text: Squeeze large spoonfuls of the mixture into clumps and space them out on the lined trays.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 40-50 min, carefully flipping the clusters with a fish slice every 15 min and swapping the trays between shelves, until deep golden.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely on the trays (they will firm up as they cool).

steps.title: Store
steps.text: Keep in an airtight container for up to 1 month.

tips: Blitz only a portion of the oats into flour; this creates helpful texture variation
Let the mixture thicken before forming clusters so it holds together better
Flip clusters carefully with a fish slice and swap trays every 15 minutes for even cooking
storage: Keep in an airtight container for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
